builtin.standard.label: Standard mode
builtin.standard.description: Handles code, files and documents; tools on demand, prompt identical to the factory one — the right default for most work
builtin.minimal.label: Minimal mode
builtin.minimal.description: Only a shell (PowerShell) and image reading, with a one-line prompt; use it to compare the model's baseline behaviour
builtin.maker.label: Maker mode
builtin.maker.description: Standard abilities plus read-only runtime queries: add modes for yourself, write plugins for dsc
builtin.ptc.label: PTC mode
builtin.ptc.description: Standard abilities plus run_code: script tool calls in bulk and filter the results in code
